formulas.rotation: k = sum(I_i/r_i^2)/m, illustrative lumped equivalent inertia
formulas.initial_power: P_initial = m*(1+k)*a*v / brake_count, level constant deceleration
formulas.stopping_distance: s = v*t_delay + v^2/(2*a), flat track; delay excludes driver recognition/reaction
formulas.minimum_mu_all_weight_braked: mu_required = [a/g + sin(theta)]/cos(theta), ideal steady whole-vehicle force balance
formulas.max_decel_adhesion: a_max = g*(mu*cos(theta)-sin(theta)), all weight on effective braked axles; no guarantee of achieving it
formulas.parking: T_hold = m*g*sin(theta)*r_wheel/brake_count, no rolling resistance credit or safety factor
formulas.fixed_loaded_torque_empty: a_empty = a_loaded*(m_loaded+m_equiv_rot)/(m_empty+m_equiv_rot), same absolute wheelset inertia; ideal before adhesion saturation
